title: Action Setting Guide
text: Action Setting Guide When an event occurs, you can define the actions that should run in response from the event action settings. You can trigger an alarm output or audio output through a camera speaker , as well as send real-time events over the network to a specific server or client using HTTP or FTP . AI Bridge also integrates with a range of VMS platforms out of the box, including Nx Witness, Cortrol, Milestone, and Genetec, so you can build a system around one of those. title: Device Installation
text: Device Installation Setting Up the AI Bridge Device Cloud Service Router cloud arrow --> AI Bridge Eth2 Eth1 router --> Setting up the AI Bridge device on the network Install the AI Bridge on a network that has internet access and a running DHCP server. Connect a network cable to the AI Bridge's Ethernet 1 port. The AI Bridge has no separate power button — it boots up as soon as the adapter is powered on. It takes about 1 minute for the device to finish booting and become reachable from a PC.

title: RS485 Modbus (Satel)
text: RS485 Modbus (Satel) 1. Introduction 1.1 Prerequisites AI Bridge firmware version 103813 or later. RS485 Modbus relay box - recommended alarm box model: ACU-220 . 1.2 Understanding the Integration Architecture When an event occurs, AI Bridge sends a signal to the ACU-220 over RS485, combined with the video. The ACU-220 is a wireless system controller that forwards the signal to wirelessly connected devices to control them. The advantage of this setup is that the ACU-220 can control up to 48 relays, and because it uses wireless communication, no additional wiring such as LAN cable is required.

title: Virtual Alarm In
text: Virtual Alarm In 1. Introduction 1.1 Prerequisites AI Bridge firmware version 100104 or later. 1.2 Understanding the Integration Architecture A virtual alarm can be turned ON or OFF from an external source by calling the API over HTTP(S). Because HTTP is used, you need to supply account credentials. For security, it's recommended to add a dedicated API-only account rather than using the admin account. Actions such as RS485, camera speaker, ONVIF, and a range of VMS integrations can be mapped to a virtual alarm event. Only ON/OFF behavior exists - if you need more, use a generic event instead.

title: VMS / Alarm Monitoring
text: VMS / Alarm Monitoring AI Bridge integrates with a wide range of third-party VMS (Video Management System) and alarm monitoring platforms. Once integrated, AI Bridge can send AI-detected events - and, in most cases, an AI-annotated video stream - directly into your existing VMS, so operators can keep working from the platform they already use. Choose your VMS from the guides below for step-by-step setup instructions.
